maps.name: Aircraft Carrier
maps.description: A tropical shipyard map centered around a grounded aircraft carrier, featuring dynamic elements like a moving barge and multiple flanking routes through naval warehouses.

conquest.mode_description: Multiple bases across a large map. Each base you hold earns your team points. Dynamic events like bombing runs and elimination challenges can shift the score. First to 2,000 wins.

control.mode_description: Capture and hold a single zone to fill your control meter. If both teams contest the zone, progress pauses. At 99%, overtime kicks in until one team clears the zone. Best of 3 rounds.

hardpoint.mode_description: A single control point moves across the map. Hold it to earn points. When one base is depleted or time runs out, the next activates. First team to 2,000 points wins.

kill_confirmed.mode_description: Destroyed vehicles drop Tokens. Collect enemy Tokens to score. Collect allied Tokens to stop the enemy earning points. Power-ups spawn on the map. First to 25 Tokens wins.
